Subject: Request: BYOK emergency revocation playbook + HSM attestation

Hi Rachel,

We're preparing for our Q1 SOC 2 re-audit and our auditors have asked for two items that we don’t yet have in the evidence packet: a documented emergency BYOK revocation playbook (steps we would follow to evict a compromised customer key) and a time-stamped HSM attestation for the current HSM cluster that will be persisted in our audit repo.

Could you please provide:
- A read-only PDF copy of the emergency revocation runbook (signed by security or ops)
- The most recent HSM attestation PDF (date-stamped)
- A delivery manifest (SHA256 checksums) for all files and a secure transfer mechanism (we prefer SFTP with a delivery log)

We need these by EOD Wednesday (2026-12-22) to hit audit timelines. If there are any data transfer agreements or DocuSign steps required for the evidence export, call that out.

Thanks,
J. Kim
Compliance Manager
OmniBank
